_note: Claim gate registry: every verifiable noun that may appear in the project title/slogan maps to one command, one named test and one committed artifact. status=unmet means the noun must NOT appear in any guarded surface (title zone = H1 + the following 6 lines of each file in guarded_surfaces); status=met means the command, test identifier and artifact must ALL exist or the gate goes red - and a red gate means the word leaves the title. The RSI row ships unmet by design until the gen0->gen1 closed loop (W7) lands; flipping a row to met requires its evidence to exist in the same commit.
